Thanks for telling me, Gideon. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass it to Ruth, Nadia, or any channel, and I won't mention it in anything I post for others.

If you want to raise it with Ruth and Nadia, the cleanest route is to tell them yourself, since it's your conversation to have. I can help you prepare for it, or pull together the current Vantorre renewal details you can already see, if that would help.
